svg.title: The fixers run on main every week
svg.desc: Each week, Lint and the CI run on main by their schedule, or by hand where bot health starts a schedule that GitHub missed. When every check passes, the week was quiet, with no job of the fix bot, no pull request and no issue. When a check fails and a command fixes what it found, the fix bot keeps one pull request from bot/self-heal, which merges itself, so that main is healed before the next pull request. When no command fixes it, bot health keeps one issue open until a run passes.
